desc: Ideation complete: linearity over edges and prefix-sum approach.

Derive and document the edge contribution probabilities: `i = v` gives `1`, `u < i < v` gives `1/i`, `i = u` gives `1 - 1/u`, `2 <= i < u` gives `2(i-1)/(i(i+1))`, and `i > v` gives `0`; multiply by `(N-1)!`.
Precompute `(N-1)! mod 998244353` and modular inverses up to `N+1`.
Build prefix arrays for `sum A_i / i` and `sum A_i * 2(i-1)/(i(i+1))` modulo `998244353`.
Implement the `O(1)` query formula separately for `u = 1` and `u >= 2`, using prefix differences and handling negative modulo values.
Validate on the samples and edge cases such as `N = 2`, `u = 1`, and adjacent vertices `v = u + 1`, ensuring efficient input/output.
Optionally brute-force validate derived probabilities for very small `N` before final implementation.
